title: Identification timestamped before its own trip started
description: The identification's claimed atSec is -120 (two minutes before the trip that will eventually run even starts); it is delivered live, at deliverAtSec 0, at the very start of playback. A timestamp 120 seconds before this trip's own start_date therefore falls outside this trip's window and outside any pre-start tolerance this flow applies. Must prove: the row persists unlinked and is never awarded. Must NOT change: neither the asset assignee nor this trip's own assignee may move, at insert time or after the trip closes.
